name: Deore XT rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 265 g for the RD-M730 assembly in the 1987 catalogue. Its documented 28–32T largest-sprocket range depends on Shimano SFR/SF fork ends; 32T is not an unconditional frame-independent limit.
